**Step 1 — Confirming the 1938 FIFA World Cup was actually held**
The tournament was held in France from 4 to 19 June 1938 (the third FIFA World Cup). Italy won, defeating Hungary 4–2 in the final. It was the last World Cup before World War II; the next was held in 1950.
